newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 dips, little effect from Agrobanka seen.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 dips, little effect from Agrobanka seen.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index slipped 2.6 points to 572.8 as the market came to terms with central bank moves to place the largest fully private Czech bank, Agrobanka, under temporary forced administration.

Agrobanka itself, which is not on the PX50 index, lost 5.34 points, the maximum daily allowable five percent, to 101.56, but analysts said the long term effect of the crisis on the market as a whole would be minimal.

"I don't think this will have much of an effect...I expect there will be more banks to have problems. The big banks know this and will position themselves against losses," said Jeff Ocenasek of Atlantik Financny Trhy.
The performance of the largest Czech banks on the Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) was mixed on Tuesday but there were no extraordinary price fluctuations.
Komercni Banka was down 28 crowns, 1.2 percent, to 2,370, Ceska Sporitelna was up seven crowns, two percent, to 359 and IPB Bank was unchanged on 302.
The less heavily capitalised and smaller Zivnostenska Banka lost 10 crowns to 2,750.

Among other blue chip issues, SPT Telecom fell 12 crowns to 3,360, IPS Praha lost nine crowns to 3,290, CEZ was unchanged on 1,048, Chemopetrol fell 15 crowns to 1,305 and Skoda Plzen rose two crowns to 1,112.
